purpose: Name the renderer latch that suppresses leading zero HUD digits.

contract.initialize: 0x001AB7C4 clears the latch before scanning HUD_DISPLAY_DIGITS.
contract.scan: The six digit loop tests the current digit against ASCII 0 and the latch.
contract.publish: 0x001AB9E2 sets the latch when the first nonzero digit is emitted; later digits are emitted even when zero.

conclusion: FFF0FE records whether a nonzero HUD digit has been seen during the current actor-record build.
